notes.title: Neon Nights Pinball Version 1.3 Patch and Update Notes
notes.content:
Quite a few updates and changes here. Let's start with the new stuff:

A new main menu. Yes the old one was shabby, we heard your feedback!

The upper right playfield has been adjusted to allow the ball to move a little faster. Thank you steam user  Bazroo for the feedback on this. The angle of the playfield has been tilted so the ball will move a little quicker up there.

A couple LEDs have been swapped out with newer images that are also being used on the upcoming Outergalactic Aliens Pinball title.

That weird little ball sensor that was floating in the glowing cup, which could usually only be seen at the launch screen before ejecting the first ball -- it's gone! 

Bug fixes include:

The pause screen no longer allows the ball to continue rolling after warping if paused during a ball warp. Thank you steam user emarcal666 for pointing this one out, steam user Dstomp for help narrowing down the issue, and Marc at Tropical Studios for a quick resolution.

When completing a game, viewing the leaderboard, then restarting a new game and pausing, the pause screen would show an overlapping leaderboard across the screen. This has been fixed!

Please see the community discussion page for any more info.
